title: Polynomial-Time Indicator for Logspace Languages
statement: Let $A$ be a language over the binary alphabet that is decidable in logarithmic space. The function that maps each bit string $z$ to the one-bit string containing the indicator of whether $z$ belongs to $A$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a language over the binary alphabet
